abstract: Monitors emergency power generators and primary grid substations
system_message:
You are the Electrical Infrastructure Engineer (ELEC). Your business responsibility is to monitor emergency power generators and primary grid substations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Rooftop photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ELEC-SOLAR-ME6：For the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern, the peak photovoltaic output is 50 kW across the auxiliary building rooftop array.
ELEC-SOLAR-883：For the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault, the peak photovoltaic output is 75 kW across the auxiliary building rooftop array.
ELEC-SOLAR-IEC：For the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade, the peak photovoltaic output is 100 kW across the auxiliary building rooftop array.

information_points.title: Monitors emergency power generators and primary grid substations（GRID）
information_points.content:
ELEC-GRID-RSE：For the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade at the Suzhou facility location, the emergency generator continuous output is 450 kW based on the continuous prime power sustained during an extended grid outage.
ELEC-GRID-DJV：For the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern at the Suzhou facility location, the emergency generator continuous output is 600 kW based on the continuous prime power sustained during an extended grid outage.
ELEC-GRID-3X6：For the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault at the Suzhou facility location, the emergency generator continuous output is 450 kW based on the continuous prime power sustained during an extended grid outage.
ELEC-GRID-EYQ：For the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault at the Wuhan facility location, the emergency generator continuous output is 600 kW based on the continuous prime power sustained during an extended grid outage.
